name: AdverseEventCaseIntakeTriage
tagline: Pharmacovigilance intake desk – four-criteria validity, seriousness, duplicate check, MedDRA coding and the 7/15/90-day reporting clock in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete adverse event intake and triage app for Power Apps and Power Pages. Log reports from calls, e-mails, literature, studies and partners; check the four minimum criteria; record seriousness criteria and watch the Day-0 clock switch between 7, 15 and 90 days; confirm duplicates; code the event to a MedDRA preferred term; assess expectedness and causality; send to four-eyes medical review and record the submission with late-reason capture. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Four minimum criteria (reporter, patient, product, event) with R/P/D/E badges
Seriousness criteria → 7-day / 15-day / 90-day report type and regulatory due date from Day 0
Provisional 15-day clock until seriousness is assessed
Duplicate detection on product + patient + event within a configurable window
MedDRA PT suggestions from the verbatim and term search (bring your licensed term list)
Gated workflow with drag-and-drop and keyboard Move to…
Submission record with recipients, ACK reference and late reason
Follow-up requests and follow-up received with new Day 0
Bulk triage, CSV export, grouping by report type / SOC / source
KPI outputs: overdue, on-time %, average submission day
